answer: Each identity must hold one capped oasis quota deed plus a 60-credit anchor bond bound to its key. Deeds trade: the first costs 40 credits and each sale adds 0.10, so the 1,000th costs about 140 and 1,000 fakes pay about 89,950 for deeds plus 60,000 in bonds. The karst ledger records one key per deed, so no deed serves a second key in one epoch. A deed-rental ring fails: withdrawals need the signature of the deed's anchor key, and a mismatch makes the oasis auditor reject the withdrawal and burn the bond. An honest agent buys one deed and one bond, recovering the bond after a clean epoch.
